failure.result: 13/14 CTest suites passed; backend failed: theProjectChooserListsFoldersAndResolvesTypedPaths, tests/backend_test.cpp:123, 'Compared lists differ at index 1. Actual app10, Expected App9'
failure.environment: final_verification_phoneuse.py copies os.environ (LANG=en_US.UTF-8, LC_ALL=C.UTF-8) into the CTest environment; focused worker runs earlier ran in a real locale

root_cause.qt_mechanism: Qt 6.12.0 (qt6-base 6.12.0-3, ICU 78.3 backend; libQt6Core links libicui18n.so.78). QCollatorPrivate::isC() is locale.language()==QLocale::C (qcollator_p.h). For the C locale the ICU back-end creates no UCollator and compares plain UTF-16 code units with the case setting only: numeric mode is ignored. QLocale("C.UTF-8") and QLocale("POSIX") are QLocale::C too.
root_cause.default_locale: QCollator() takes QLocale().collation(). Without QLocale::setDefault that is the system collation from LC_ALL / LC_COLLATE / LANG: C under LC_ALL=C, C.UTF-8 or POSIX, and also C under LANG=de_DE.UTF-8 with LC_COLLATE=C. After QLocale::setDefault(x), QCollator() uses x.
root_cause.probe: qa/collprobe/probe.cpp and p2.cpp (untracked, gitignored) printed for each environment: C/C.UTF-8/POSIX order APP1|app1|app10|App9|...|Zebra|Äpfel|... and NFC vs NFD compare -135; en-US/de-DE/sv-SE/ar-AE/ja-JP numeric (App9<app10) with NFC==NFD; all 51 i18n/languages.json formatLocale values parse to a real language (0 to C).
root_cause.production: The app calls Backend::applyLanguage in main.cpp before the UI; it always sets QLocale::setDefault to the interface language's formatLocale (en-US fallback). So the running desktop and phone app sorted naturally even under LC_ALL=C.UTF-8, as root's desktop-ui and phone-routes suites (which go through setLanguage) showed. The defect was a latent fallback gap: folderListing silently lost natural order whenever the process default collation was C (any process or path that did not apply an interface language).
root_cause.test: BackendTest never applies a language, so it inherited the C collation from root's LC_ALL=C.UTF-8: an implicit test locale, which the focused worker runs (real locale) did not expose.
root_cause.classification: Both: an implicitly locale-dependent test plus a real (latent) production fallback defect; fixed in the code, with a locale-bound test that fails on the old code.

fix.code: src/backend.cpp Backend::folderListing: QCollator collator; if its locale is QLocale::C, setLocale(QLocale(English, UnitedStates)) (the source language and applyLanguage's own fallback, CLDR root order); then numeric mode and case-insensitive as before. Every real locale keeps its own collation, unchanged. Tie-break by code units unchanged.
fix.comparator: ICU collation is a total preorder; equal-collating names are ordered by QString operator< (code units), distinct within one directory, so the comparator is a strict weak (in fact total) order and std::stable_sort's result does not depend on readdir order (asserted).
fix.no_global_side_effects: No setlocale, no QLocale::setDefault and no environment change in production code; nothing outside folderListing changed.
fix.backend_limit: Qt's non-ICU POSIX collator back-end does not support numeric mode in any locale; this host (qt6-base, ICU 78.3) and both portable packages (Qt binaries with ICU 73.2, packaging/portable/Dockerfile and Dockerfile.aarch64) use ICU.

tests.existing_unchanged: theProjectChooserListsFoldersAndResolvesTypedPaths is unchanged (same assertions, still runs in the process locale, i.e. root's C.UTF-8).
tests.new: theProjectChooserOrdersFoldersNaturallyInEveryLocale with 8 rows: C, C.UTF-8, POSIX (English order), en-US, de-DE (Ä beside A), sv-SE (Ä after Z, Ü as Y: own order, not English for all), ar-AE (Arabic script first, Arabic-Indic digits ٢ before ١٠), ja-JP (kana/kanji before Arabic). 17 entries: APP1/app1 case tie, App9/app10, a symlink 'link to app1', U+0308 decomposed and U+00DC composed 'Über' (canonically equal: code-unit tie-break), 'Überlänge العربية', 250-character names ending 2 and 10, Äpfel, Zebra, Arabic and Japanese names. The listing is checked for two creation orders.
tests.locale_bounding: Each row sets QLocale::setDefault inside a block with a qScopeGuard that restores the previous default (also on a failing QCOMPARE), then asserts QLocale() and QCollator().locale() equal the values before. The row asserts QCollator() starts from the row's language, so the C rows really exercise Qt's C collation.
